visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A high-intensity orange flame erupts from a black frying pan on a professional gas stove. The background is a clean metallic kitchen backsplash with bright industrial lighting. No characters are visible in this opening shot, focusing purely on the cooking action. (2) A main character's hands appear, using black chopsticks to manipulate various food items. A thick, glazed hamburger steak is lifted over a bed of white rice in a black plastic bento box. A fried egg with a bright yellow, runny yolk is placed on top of the meat, and the yolk breaks, coating the steak. The setting is a brightly lit indoor restaurant table with a warm wooden surface. (3) The camera focus shifts to individual side dishes: black seaweed shreds, yellow tamagoyaki, brown burdock, and purple cabbage. A piece of golden-brown fried chicken is held by chopsticks over a small container of white tartar sauce. The lighting remains bright and natural, highlighting the textures of the food. (4) A hand pours a liquid egg mixture into a pan containing fried pork cutlets to make a Katsudon. The shot cuts to a bowl where a slice of the thick pork cutlet, topped with shredded seaweed and onions, is lifted with a spoon. The environment is a clean commercial kitchen area. (5) Slices of rare, pink sous-vide beef are arranged in a bowl, and an onsen egg is carefully poured over the center from a spoon. The scene then transitions to the storefront, showing a wooden entrance, a sign with Japanese text, and the exterior of the building on a city street.
